2024.note: Challenging year with mildew pressure; selective producers made excellent wines.

2023.note: Exceptional across the board. Rich, ripe, and balanced.

2022.note: Hot, dry year producing concentrated, powerful wines.

2021.note: Small crop due to frost. Elegant, pure wines reward patience.

2020.note: Superb year. Ripe yet fresh, great aging potential.

2019.note: Warm year, opulent and generous wines. Drink earlier than 2020.

2018.note: Hot vintage. Whites sometimes lack freshness; reds are rich.

2017.note: Small crop post-frost. Underrated classic style.

2016.note: Frost hit reds hard; whites (Meursault, Puligny) are outstanding.

2015.note: Classic great vintage. Ripe, structured, long-lived reds.

2014.note: Excellent whites. Chablis Grand Crus are benchmarks.

2013.note: Difficult year. Best wines are elegant if austere.

2012.note: Small crop, high quality for patient producers.

2011.note: Heterogeneous vintage. Some elegant, perfumed wines emerged in skilled hands.

2010.note: One of the great vintages of the era. Exceptional aging potential.
